scenarios.description: Canonical idle rung at 10 RPS (fit split, primary region).
Canonical normal rung at 100 RPS (fit split, primary region).
Canonical peak rung at 500 RPS (fit split, primary region).
Canonical burst rung at 1000 RPS (holdout). Completeness is derived from a full CloudWatch + k6 collect. The catalog does not badge burst as measured.
1000 RPS diagnostic expecting APP_POOL_SIZE=40. Re-apply terraform with app_pool_size=40 first. Will not run against the default 250-pool topology.
1000 RPS diagnostic hitting GET /api/cpu-spin only. Requires complete per-node, CloudWatch, and k6 evidence.
Later-day holdout. Distinct scenario key and k6 SCENARIO=later-day. Setup fails unless the current UTC calendar day is strictly after the fit campaign date. Not a rename of normal.
Second-region holdout in us-west-2. Distinct scenario key and k6 SCENARIO=second-region. Setup fails if Terraform region is us-east-1. Not a rename of the primary-region run.
Typical profile fit rung at 20 total RPS (required). Requires app_profile=typical, app_workers=2, and Terraform region us-east-2.
Typical profile fit rung at 100 total RPS (required). Requires app_profile=typical, app_workers=2, and Terraform region us-east-2.
Typical profile fit rung at 200 total RPS (required). Requires app_profile=typical, app_workers=2, and Terraform region us-east-2.
Typical profile holdout rung at 300 total RPS (required). Requires app_profile=typical, app_workers=2, and Terraform region us-east-2.
Typical profile saturation rung at 500 total RPS (holdout, diagnostic, optional). Requires app_profile=typical, app_workers=2, and Terraform region us-east-2.

Typical-profile later-day holdout at 100 total RPS. Same load/typical.js mix as typical-fit-100. Requires app_profile=typical, app_workers=2, pool 250, and Terraform region us-east-2. Setup fails unless the current UTC calendar day is strictly after the fit campaign date (CWM_FIT_CAMPAIGN_DATE or adapter state). Not a rename of typical-fit-100 and not the lean later-day key.

Typical-profile later-day holdout at 300 total RPS. Same load/typical.js mix as typical-holdout-300. Requires app_profile=typical, app_workers=2, pool 250, and Terraform region us-east-2. Setup fails unless the current UTC calendar day is strictly after the fit campaign date (CWM_FIT_CAMPAIGN_DATE or adapter state). Not a rename of typical-holdout-300 and not the lean later-day key.

Typical-profile second-region holdout at 100 total RPS in us-west-2. Same load/typical.js mix as typical-fit-100. Requires app_profile=typical, app_workers=2, and pool 250. Setup fails unless Terraform region is us-west-2. Other typical keys stay locked to us-east-2. Not a rename of the us-east-2 typical apply and not the lean second-region key.

Typical-profile second-region holdout at 300 total RPS in us-west-2. Same load/typical.js mix as typical-holdout-300. Requires app_profile=typical, app_workers=2, and pool 250. Setup fails unless Terraform region is us-west-2. Other typical keys, including typical-holdout-300, stay locked to us-east-2. Not a rename of the us-east-2 typical apply and not the lean second-region key.

matrixNote: Implemented keys come from this repo (load/scenarios.js, load/diagnostics.js, load/typical.js, schema holdout) and the public CWM accuracy rungs idle/normal/peak/burst. No unverified CWM-internal keys were added. Burst and CPU-only require complete collect evidence before they are treated as measured. typical-* keys run only against app_profile=typical and app_workers=2. They require us-east-2, except typical-second-region and typical-second-region-300, which require us-west-2. typical-later-day and typical-later-day-300 also require a later UTC day than the fit campaign.
